[LGRA.5.8.9] **A `Json` integer is a 64-bit signed integer.** JSON text holding
an integer literal, one written with no fraction and no exponent, whose value
lies outside the range of a 64-bit signed integer is malformed. A runtime **must** refuse such text wherever it parses JSON
text, whoever supplies it, as it refuses any other malformed text: a host call
that parses it returns `DS_ERR_PARSE` ([NERR.5]) and changes nothing. A runtime
**must not** saturate the literal to the nearest representable integer, and
**must not** read it as a float.

So `9223372036854775807` and `-9223372036854775808` are integers a `Json` value
holds, and `9223372036854775808` and `-9223372036854775809` are malformed text.
